picker.add: Add an illustration or a logo
picker.hint: Optional · PNG, JPEG or WebP, 5 MB max · any size accepted, you choose the area to keep

COVER.label: Illustration
COVER.hint: Fills the tournament banner. Click the preview to choose the point that must stay visible.

CONTAIN.label: Logo
CONTAIN.hint: Always shown in full, in a badge next to the name — ideal with a transparent background.

picker.focusAria: Focal point: {x}% from the left, {y}% from the top
picker.focusHint: Click or drag on the image; with the keyboard, arrows (Shift to go faster), Home to recenter.
picker.logoHint: The logo is shown in full next to the tournament name, on its page as on the cards. A transparent background works best.
